propositions: The workflow editor must expose a read-only Effective Policy view derived from CriteriaSnapshot while keeping Authored Workflow as the only editable YAML/BPMN topology.
Project code-review LLM criteria must have non-empty repository-relative applies_to globs; missing or empty selectors are rejected with remedy "use [\"**\"] for repository-wide".
Effective Policy panel displays snapshot digest, criterion id, gate, tier, posture, applicability, and enabled/disabled state without serializing edits back to workflow or project routing.
Built-in entries, project DET criteria, and plan-review criteria retain distinct trigger authoring controls and are exempt from the applies_to glob validation rule.
Snapshot load or validation failure marks Effective Policy unavailable with actionable error; invalid policy never permits save and defaults are never silently substituted.
Authored workflow must round-trip byte-equivalently while Effective Policy updates reflect only derived policy changes.
